name: Processing of Application for Change of Enrollment
processing_steps: Accept, evaluate, and sign the ACE Form (Adding of Subjects)
Tag the subject(s) indicated in the ACE Form
Accept payment and issue official receipt (for students not covered by R.A. 10931)
Accept the fully accomplished ACE Form
Submit ACE Form to Registrar's Office
expected_output: Enrolled additional subject/s tagged in SIS

intake_fields.label: Accomplished ACE Form (Adding of Subject)

name: Processing of Application for Cross-Enrollment
required_documents: Application Letter for Cross-Enrollment; Permit to Cross-Enroll
processing_steps: Evaluate letter provided by the student
Approve or deny request for cross-enrollment
If approved, recommend cross-enrollment and advise student to proceed to the Registrar's Office
Approve cross-enrollment
Issue permit to cross-enroll
Advise student to process the permit to the university where student intends to cross-enroll
expected_output: Permit to cross-enroll issued to the student

intake_fields.label: Application Letter for Cross-Enrollment (1 Original + 1 Photocopy)
Permit to Cross-Enroll (3 Original Copies, from University/Campus Registrar)

name: Processing of Manual Enrollment
processing_steps: Accept and sign the R0 form (Faculty member assigned to the subject)
Accept, evaluate, and sign the R0 form (Director/Head of Academic Program)
Tag the subject(s) indicated in the R0 Form
Accept payment and issue official receipt (Cashier's Office)
expected_output: Student manually enrolled and subjects tagged in SIS

intake_fields.label: Manual Enrollment Form (R0) (1 Original + 1 Photocopy, from respective campus offices)

name: Processing of Application for Overload of Subjects
required_documents: Request Letter for Overload; SIS Generated Curriculum Profile; Request for Overload Form; Fully-accomplished ACE Form; Certificate of Registration (current semester)
processing_steps: Check requirements presented
Verify correctness of documents by checking the SIS grade file of the student
Recommend the request for approval of the Director
Approve or deny the request (Campus Director)
Add corresponding units in the student account through SIS Academic Management System
Advise student to proceed to Application for Change of Enrollment Process (Adding of Subject/s)
expected_output: Overload units added to student SIS account; student proceeds to ACE process

intake_fields.label: Request Letter for Overload (1 Original Copy, prepared by the client)
SIS Generated Curriculum Profile (1 Original Copy, from client SIS account)
Fully-accomplished Request for Overload Form (3 Original Copies, from respective campus)
Fully-accomplished ACE Form (3 Original Copies, from PUP website)
Certificate of Registration for the current semester (1 Original Copy, from Admissions Office)
SIS Generated Curriculum Profile — for verification (1 Original Copy, from student SIS account)

name: Processing of Application for Correction of Grade Entry, Late Reporting of Grades and Removal of Incomplete Mark
required_documents: Completion Form (3 copies); Copy of Class Record (3 copies); Notarized Affidavit for Change of Grade
processing_steps: Accept payment and issue an official receipt
Evaluate the requirements; compute and give grade to the student
Receive the accomplished completion form, class record, and student requirements with notarized affidavit
Sign the Completion Form
Log and forward all requirements to the Registrar's Office
Sign the Completion Form and tag the accomplished grade to SIS
Return one (1) copy of the completion form to the student
expected_output: Corrected or completed grade tagged in SIS; student receives copy of completion form

intake_fields.label: Completion Form (3 Original Copies, downloadable from PUP website)
Copy of Class Record (3 Original Copies, from assigned professor)
Notarized Affidavit for Change of Grade (for correction of entry or late reporting, from Notary Public)

name: Processing of Application for Shifting
required_documents: Certified Copy of Grades; Fully-accomplished Shifting Form
processing_steps: Collect payment from student
Print the copy of grades
Certify the copy of grades
Check the fully-accomplished shifting form
Evaluate certified copy of grades
Interview and assess student capability and skills
Accept student in the program and sign the acceptance portion of the shifting form
Sign the release portion of the shifting form
Advise student to proceed to the Director's Office for final approval
Sign the approval portion of the shifting form
Advise student to proceed to the Registrar's Office for transfer of credentials and enrollment
expected_output: Approved shifting form; student transferred to new program and proceeds to Registrar for enrollment

intake_fields.label: Certified Copy of Grades (1 Original + 1 Photocopy, from Admissions Office)
Fully-accomplished Shifting Form (3 copies, from respective campus offices)

name: Processing of Online Petition of Subject

Endorse petition to the OVPC

Forward the approved petition to the ICTO
Create section offering of the approved petitioned subject
Tag students through SIS Academic Management System
expected_output: Petitioned subject section created; students tagged and enrolled through SIS

intake_fields.label: Online Petition of Subject (3 copies, submitted via apps.pup.edu.ph/sisstudent/Login)

Evaluate the request for tutorial and approve as necessary
Forward the approved request to the ICTO
Create section offering of the tutorial subject
Tag students through SIS Academic Management System

name: Processing of Request for Correction of Name in Conformity with the Philippines Statistics Authority Certificate of Live Birth and/or Correction of Name in the School Records
office: Campus Student Services and Affairs Office
responsible_unit: Campus Student Services and Affairs Office
required_documents: Letter to Campus Registrar; PSA Birth Certificate; Affidavit of Discrepancy; Joint Affidavit; F137A/TOR (if applicable); TOR and Diploma (if previously issued); General Clearance; 2x2 ID Picture (2 pcs); Proof of Payment; Brown Envelope; Authorization documents (if representative)
processing_steps: Accept payment and issue official receipt
Request client to sign logbook; accept application and documents; conduct initial assessment and verification of completeness; indicate tentative release date; return client copy of application form
Process request; issue advisory and updates as necessary; notify client when document is ready for release
Verify documents presented; issue the requested certification
Request client to sign the logbook and evaluate the service rendered
expected_output: Corrected name reflected in school records and SIS; certification/s issued to the client

Authorization Letter and Valid ID (if claimant is an immediate family member)
Special Power of Attorney (SPA) (if claimant is other than immediate family member)
